checks.name: static
run: go build ./... && go vet ./... && go run ./cmd/lint ./... && test -z "$(gofmt -l .)"

checks.name: budget
run: f=$(mktemp) && GORACE=atexit_sleep_ms=0 go test -race -count=1 -p 1 -json ./... > "$f"; a=$?; go run ./cmd/testtime -title Unit -job go -time-allowance 1.15 < "$f"; b=$?; rm -f "$f"; test $a -eq 0 && test $b -eq 0
